caption:
咪寶盯著大戰場
小草在風中搖晃
她屏住呼吸
準備發動致命一擊
然而那只是
一根路過的牙籤
她嚇得原地跳起
scene: A tiny brown short-haired tabby kitten with hazel eyes and a white chin, Mimi Bao, crouches in a lush backyard garden. She is frozen in a dramatic hunting pose behind a single dandelion. Sunlight filters through blades of grass, casting a soft glow on her intense expression as she prepares to pounce on a fallen wooden toothpick.
